fact: The World Bank's aide-memoire for the PGNSP mid-term mission of 30 September to 4 October 2024 says the finance ministry signed a contract with the software publisher XUXXEX on 2 September 2024 to help the government operate and take up SIM_Ba, alongside delegated project management support, and that the line-ministry business representatives meant to support the SIM_Ba team were not in place.
title: Mission d'appui à la mise en oeuvre et de revue à mi-parcours, Projet de Gouvernance Numérique du Secteur Public (PGNSP), 30 septembre au 4 octobre 2024, Aide-mémoire
